topic_title: 弗兰科·巴雷西逝世讣告
lead_source_title: Franco Baresi obituary
lead_source_summary: Italian footballer who captained AC Milan for 15 of his 20 seasons, a period of unprecedented success for the club At a time when Italian football was known for the excellence of its defensive systems, Franco Baresi, who has died aged 66 after a period of ill health, embodied its most prized qualities.
